clue.text: Female I punish for changing end

indicators.note: changing tells us the letters of punish are altered into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone imposes a penalty on a woman so that she will alter how things conclude.
explanation.definitionFit: To conclude or wind up something is to bring it to a close, a phrasal verb synonym.

clue.text: I, on river, going round large country

indicators.note: going round means the river's letters surround the other piece

parts.note: the Tay is a Scottish river
L is the abbreviation for large, as on clothing

explanation.surface: I travel along a river that circles a big nation.
explanation.walkthrough: The Tay is Scotland's longest river.
explanation.definitionFit: This Mediterranean nation, with Rome as its capital, is a country in southern Europe.

clue.text: I'd murderous foes, on parade for Caesar's last day?

indicators.note: on places the parade word after the scrambled letters

parts.note: taken as written, apostrophe dropped

indicators.note: murderous suggests violent upheaval, so the letters of foes are scrambled

parts.note: a parade of troops is a march

explanation.surface: Caesar speaks of his killers marching in procession on the day of his death.
explanation.definitionFit: Julius Caesar was assassinated on 15 March 44 BC, the date the Romans called the Ides; the question mark flags the playful definition.

clue.text: Generous applause? A little

parts.note: to give someone a big hand is to applaud, so hands is applause
a little means some, a moderate amount

explanation.surface: Is a little clapping a generous reception?
explanation.definitionFit: A handsome sum or reward is a liberal, generous one.

clue.text: Fitness expert having peculiar gym shoe

parts.note: peculiar in the sense of belonging to one person, personal
trainers is the British word for sports shoes or sneakers

explanation.surface: A gym coach wears odd sports footwear.
explanation.definitionFit: A coach who works one-to-one with a client on exercise is a fitness professional.

clue.text: German writer leaves unfinished article

indicators.note: unfinished means the word loses its final letter

parts.note: leaves as a verb means departs, goes
the definite article in English

explanation.surface: A German author abandons an essay before completing it.
explanation.definitionFit: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe was the great German poet and dramatist who wrote Faust.

clue.text: Good passage in ship

parts.note: an alley is a narrow passage between buildings

explanation.surface: A fine corridor runs through a vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: A galley is a low ship propelled by oars, used in ancient and medieval times.

clue.text: Food item, for example, put on top of gammon

indicators.note: in a down clue, put on top of places the first piece above the second
top of picks out the first letter of gammon

explanation.surface: A cook places, say, a fried topping on a slice of ham.
explanation.walkthrough: Gammon is British cured ham, often served with a fried egg on top.
explanation.definitionFit: The laid ovum of a hen, eaten boiled, fried or scrambled, is a common food item.

clue.text: Stew at office, initially an awkward situation

parts.note: hotpot is a Lancashire stew of meat and potato

indicators.note: initially picks out the first letter of office

explanation.surface: A casserole served at work creates difficulty.
explanation.walkthrough: Lancashire hotpot is a traditional baked stew from the north of England.
explanation.definitionFit: A delicate issue that nobody wants to handle is an idiom for a tricky predicament.

clue.text: Wear kid

definitions.meaning: to be dressed in, as of clothes on the body
to tease or fool someone playfully

explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means both to be dressed in something and, informally, to trick or tease a person.

clue.text: Demote ambassador after the Queen returns

indicators.note: after places the ambassador's word following the turned letters
returns signals that the Queen's letters are read backwards

parts.note: ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the crossword shorthand for the Queen
a legate is a papal envoy or ambassador

explanation.surface: An envoy is stripped of rank once the monarch comes back.
explanation.definitionFit: To relegate is to move someone or something to a lower rank or division, a synonym for downgrading.

clue.text: Printer's error in publicity poster

indicators.note: in signals that the answer is concealed within the words publicity poster

explanation.surface: A misprint has slipped onto an advertising placard.
explanation.definitionFit: A misprint or typing slip is commonly called by this short informal word for a typographical error.

clue.text: Artisan put one inside ornate stamnos

indicators.note: inside tells us one word is placed within the other
ornate suggests elaborate decoration, so the letters of stamnos are worked into a fancy new arrangement

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A craftsman sets something into a decorated ancient Greek wine jar.
explanation.walkthrough: A stamnos is an ancient Greek storage jar; its letters rearranged give STMASON, which ONE goes inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A skilled worker who cuts and dresses building stone is a craftsman, a kind of artisan.

clue.text: A dry male requiring large drink quickly

parts.note: TT means teetotal, i.e. dry, abstaining from alcohol
he is the male pronoun
a double is a large measure of spirits

explanation.surface: A teetotal man nonetheless needs a big drink.
explanation.definitionFit: A military phrase for running, it means very fast, hence quickly.

clue.text: Mame — twice shortened one, a musical

indicators.note: twice means the shortened word is written two times in a row
shortened means the word loses its last letter

parts.note: Mame is itself the title of a Broadway musical, used here just for its letters
one is the Roman numeral I
taken as written

explanation.surface: A comparison of musical theatre: Mame is one show, cut down, set against another.
explanation.walkthrough: Mame shortened gives MAM; twice gives MAMMAM, then I and A follow.
explanation.definitionFit: The ABBA-based stage show is a jukebox musical, later filmed with Meryl Streep.

clue.text: Place a pin nervously in device

indicators.note: nervously suggests jittery movement, so the letters of place a pin are jumbled

explanation.surface: Someone fumbles while inserting a pin into a gadget.
explanation.definitionFit: A machine for a household task, like a toaster or washer, is a device.

clue.text: Rejected some gin

indicators.note: rejected suggests something sent back, so the word is read in reverse

parts.note: some means a portion, a part

explanation.surface: Some of the gin was sent back as unacceptable.
explanation.definitionFit: A gin is a snare for catching animals, so the two words are synonyms in that sense.

clue.text: Object after silly sketch

indicators.note: silly suggests foolishness, so the letters of after are rearranged

parts.note: a sketch in comedy is a short act

explanation.surface: An item appears following a foolish comedy skit.
explanation.definitionFit: A man-made item, especially one of historical interest, is an object.

clue.text: Box in last of fights on equal footing

indicators.note: last of picks out the final letter of the word fights

parts.note: on a par means equal, so par gives the sense of equal footing

explanation.surface: A boxer competes in the final bout with nobody holding the advantage.
explanation.definitionFit: To box lightly in practice, exchanging blows without full force, is to spar.

clue.text: Excited? No!

parts.note: the answer read as instructions says take the word on and turn it round, which spells the clue word no

explanation.surface: Asked whether they were thrilled, someone flatly refuses.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone aroused or stimulated with interest or desire is said to be in this excited state.

clue.text: Hail we suffered, for a short time

indicators.note: suffered suggests being knocked about, so the letters of hail we are disturbed

explanation.surface: We endured a hailstorm, but only briefly.
explanation.definitionFit: This adverb means for a brief period, a while.

clue.text: Sea creature's appropriate cry is heard

parts.note: appropriate means correct, right

indicators.note: is heard signals that the word for cry is to be taken by its sound

parts.note: a wail is a long mournful cry

explanation.surface: A marine animal's fitting call carries across the water.
explanation.definitionFit: This large baleen species was historically the favoured catch of whalers, a type of marine mammal.

clue.text: Vow — old hat, possibly

indicators.note: possibly indicates that the letters may be arranged differently

explanation.surface: A promise is dismissed as a tired cliche.
explanation.definitionFit: A solemn promise, especially one sworn in court or before God, is a vow.

clue.text: Jeering remark beginning to trouble relative

indicators.note: beginning to picks out the first letter of trouble

parts.note: an aunt is a relative

explanation.surface: A family member's mocking comment starts trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: A provoking, mocking insult is a jeer or gibe.

clue.text: Not working at home on case

indicators.note: on places one piece beside the other in the charade

parts.note: in means at home, as in staying in
a case in law is a lawsuit, an action

explanation.surface: Someone stays idle in the house while a legal case is under way.
explanation.definitionFit: A state of idleness or failure to act is the absence of activity, i.e. not working.

clue.text: Swan caught, then died

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
ob., from Latin obiit, is the abbreviation for died

explanation.surface: A swan was captured and then perished.
explanation.definitionFit: The male swan is called a cob, the female a pen.

clue.text: Husband leaving nurse in leafy glade

indicators.note: leaving tells us the husband letter departs from the word for nurse

parts.note: to nurse a grudge is to harbour it

explanation.surface: A man walks out on his nurse in a shady woodland spot.
explanation.definitionFit: A bower or shady garden retreat formed by trees and climbing plants is a leafy shelter.

clue.text: Ineffective bishop in touch with leader of Evangelists

indicators.note: in places the bishop's letter within the word for touch

parts.note: to touch is to feel
B is the chess abbreviation for bishop

indicators.note: leader of picks out the first letter of Evangelists

explanation.surface: A weak clergyman keeps in contact with the head of the evangelical movement.
explanation.definitionFit: Lacking strength or force, a weak effort is ineffective.

clue.text: Climbs down — tree rats about

indicators.note: about signals the letters of tree rats are moved around

explanation.surface: Rodents in the branches come back down to the ground.
explanation.definitionFit: To climb down in an argument is to back off or withdraw, a figurative synonym.
